title: Reading 3B Ch 1–2: Stories, Magic Potions & Children's Messages

questions.q: In the story 'Amy and Snowy', why did the other ducks laugh at Snowy at first?
questions.answer: Because Snowy was big and grey, not yellow like them.
options: Because Snowy was big and grey, not yellow like them.
Because Snowy ate all their food.
questions.explain: 根據故事，Snowy 起初又大又灰，跟其他黃色小鴨不同，長大後才發現是一隻美麗的白天鵝（swan）。
questions.passage: Amy lives near a pond. One spring, five baby ducks hatch. Four are small and yellow. One is big and grey. The other ducks laugh at him. Amy calls him Snowy and is kind to him. Months later, Snowy grows up into a beautiful white swan.
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: In the story 'Amy and Snowy', why did the other ducks laugh at Snowy at first?
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Reading 3B Ch 1–2: Stories, Magic Potions & Children's Messages

questions.q: In the Magic Potions advertisement, who wrote a review for 'Hair-grow'?
questions.explain: 根據廣告，長髮公主 Rapunzel 推薦令頭髮變長的魔藥 Hair-grow。
questions.passage:
MAGIC POTIONS – try our best potions!
Hair-grow: Make your hair long and shiny. 'I love it!' – Rapunzel
Body-power: Be strong like a giant. 'I feel so strong!' – The Giant

questions.q: In the story, why did Spod pass the Maths test while his friends failed?
questions.answer: Because Spod studied hard while his friends played and ate.
options: Because Spod copied his friend's answers.
Because Spod studied hard while his friends played and ate.
Because Spod's dad was the teacher.
Because the test was very easy.
questions.explain: 根據故事，Spod 留在家裏努力溫習數學，而其他朋友只顧玩耍和吃東西。
questions.passage: Spod and his friends have a Maths test on Monday. At the weekend, his friends play games and eat snacks. Spod stays at home and studies hard. On Monday, Spod passes the test, but his friends fail.
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: In the story, why did Spod pass the Maths test while his friends failed?

questions.q: On the Sunny Days Children's Centre message board, what did Paul do with the old people?
questions.answer: He visited an old people's home and played games with them.
options: He went bird-watching in Tai Po Kau.
He visited an old people's home and played games with them.
questions.explain: 根據留言板，Paul 探訪老人院並與長者一起玩遊戲。
questions.passage:
Sunny Days Children's Centre – Message Board
Paul: Last Saturday I visited an old people's home. I played games with the old people. It was fun!
Jenny: I went bird-watching in Tai Po Kau. I saw many birds.
